title: Substation Analog & Binary Integrity Poll Profile
description: Basic IEEE 1815 DNP3 outstation device profile for a 138 kV distribution substation RTU exposing breaker status, bus voltage, and feeder current for Class 0 integrity polling.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<DNP3DeviceProfile xmlns="http://www.dnp.org/DNP3/DeviceProfile/2010" id="SUB_138KV_RTU_01">
  <DeviceIdentity>
    <Vendor>Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories</Vendor>
    <DeviceName>SEL-3530 Substation RTAC</DeviceName>
    <Version>3.4.0</Version>
  </DeviceIdentity>
  <CommunicationSettings>
    <OutstationAddress>101</OutstationAddress>
    <MasterAddress>1</MasterAddress>
  </CommunicationSettings>
  <DNP3PointList>
    <BinaryInputs>
      <BinaryInput index="0" name="CB_52A_CLOSED" class="1" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="1" name="CB_52B_OPEN" class="1" normalState="0"/>
      <BinaryInput index="2" name="RELAY_86_LOCKOUT" class="1" normalState="0"/>
    </BinaryInputs>
    <BinaryOutputs>
      <BinaryOutput index="0" name="CB_52_TRIP_CMD"/>
      <BinaryOutput index="1" name="CB_52_CLOSE_CMD"/>
    </BinaryOutputs>
    <AnalogInputs>
      <AnalogInput index="0" name="BUS_VOLTAGE_KV" class="2" deadband="0.25" mult="0.01" offset="0.0" units="kV" min="0" max="160"/>
      <AnalogInput index="1" name="FEEDER_CURRENT_A" class="2" deadband="2.0" mult="0.1" offset="0.0" units="A" min="0" max="1200"/>
    </AnalogInputs>
    <AnalogOutputs>
      <AnalogOutput index="0" name="LTC_VOLTAGE_SETPOINT_KV" units="kV" min="130" max="145"/>
    </AnalogOutputs>
    <Counters>
      <Counter index="0" name="FEEDER_IMPORT_KWH" class="3" units="kWh"/>
    </Counters>
  </DNP3PointList>
</DNP3DeviceProfile>

title: Class 1/2/3 Unsolicited Event Reporting Outstation
description: IEEE 1815 outstation configuration separating high-priority protection trips (Class 1), analog deadband excursions (Class 2), and energy accumulator rollovers (Class 3) for unsolicited reporting.
code:

  <DeviceIdentity>
    <Vendor>GE Vernova</Vendor>
    <DeviceName>D20MX Substation Controller</DeviceName>
    <Version>4.1.2</Version>
  </DeviceIdentity>

    <OutstationAddress>204</OutstationAddress>
    <MasterAddress>1</MasterAddress>

    <BinaryInputs>
      <BinaryInput index="0" name="PROT_87T_DIFF_TRIP" class="1" normalState="0"/>
      <BinaryInput index="1" name="PROT_51G_GROUND_TRIP" class="1" normalState="0"/>
      <BinaryInput index="2" name="SF6_GAS_LOW_ALARM" class="1" normalState="0"/>
      <BinaryInput index="3" name="DC_BATTERY_CHARGER_OK" class="2" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="4" name="PANEL_DOOR_INTRUSION" class="3" normalState="0"/>
    </BinaryInputs>
    <BinaryOutputs>
      <BinaryOutput index="0" name="ALARM_ACK_RESET"/>
      <BinaryOutput index="1" name="COOLING_FAN_STAGE1"/>
    </BinaryOutputs>

      <AnalogInput index="0" name="XFMR_TOP_OIL_TEMP_C" class="2" deadband="1.0" mult="0.1" offset="0.0" units="C" min="-20" max="120"/>
      <AnalogInput index="1" name="XFMR_HOTSPOT_TEMP_C" class="2" deadband="1.0" mult="0.1" offset="0.0" units="C" min="-20" max="150"/>

title: Select-Before-Operate (SBO) Circuit Breaker Control
description: High-security DNP3 bay controller profile implementing Select-Before-Operate CROB points, synchrocheck permissives, and remote/local interlock feedback for a 345 kV breaker-and-a-half bay.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<DNP3DeviceProfile xmlns="http://www.dnp.org/DNP3/DeviceProfile/2010" id="BAY_345KV_BCU_03">
  <DeviceIdentity>
    <Vendor>Hitachi Energy</Vendor>
    <DeviceName>REC670 Bay Control Unit</DeviceName>
    <Version>2.2.5</Version>
  </DeviceIdentity>
  <CommunicationSettings>
    <OutstationAddress>345</OutstationAddress>
    <MasterAddress>2</MasterAddress>
  </CommunicationSettings>
  <DNP3PointList>
    <BinaryInputs>
      <BinaryInput index="0" name="CB_345_1_CLOSED" class="1" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="1" name="CB_345_1_SPRING_CHARGED" class="1" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="2" name="SYNCHROCHECK_25_PERMISSIVE" class="1" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="3" name="REMOTE_CONTROL_ENABLED" class="1" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="4" name="DISCONNECT_89A_CLOSED" class="2" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="5" name="GROUND_SWITCH_89G_OPEN" class="1" normalState="1"/>
    </BinaryInputs>
    <BinaryOutputs>
      <BinaryOutput index="0" name="SBO_CB_345_1_TRIP"/>
      <BinaryOutput index="1" name="SBO_CB_345_1_CLOSE"/>
      <BinaryOutput index="2" name="SBO_89A_OPEN"/>
      <BinaryOutput index="3" name="SBO_89A_CLOSE"/>
      <BinaryOutput index="4" name="SBO_RECLOSER_79_ENABLE"/>
    </BinaryOutputs>
    <AnalogInputs>
      <AnalogInput index="0" name="LINE_VOLTAGE_KV" class="2" deadband="0.5" mult="0.01" offset="0.0" units="kV" min="0" max="400"/>
      <AnalogInput index="1" name="BUS_VOLTAGE_KV" class="2" deadband="0.5" mult="0.01" offset="0.0" units="kV" min="0" max="400"/>
      <AnalogInput index="2" name="SYNC_PHASE_ANGLE_DEG" class="2" deadband="0.5" mult="0.1" offset="0.0" units="deg" min="-180" max="180"/>
      <AnalogInput index="3" name="ACTIVE_POWER_MW" class="2" deadband="1.5" mult="0.1" offset="0.0" units="MW" min="-600" max="600"/>
      <AnalogInput index="4" name="REACTIVE_POWER_MVAR" class="2" deadband="1.5" mult="0.1" offset="0.0" units="MVAR" min="-300" max="300"/>
    </AnalogInputs>
    <AnalogOutputs>
      <AnalogOutput index="0" name="SYNC_MAX_ANGLE_DEG" units="deg" min="5" max="30"/>
      <AnalogOutput index="1" name="SYNC_MAX_SLIP_HZ" units="Hz" min="0.02" max="0.5"/>
    </AnalogOutputs>
    <Counters>
      <Counter index="0" name="CB_345_1_OP_COUNT" class="3" units="ops"/>
      <Counter index="1" name="CB_345_1_FAULT_DUTY_KA2" class="3" units="kA2"/>
    </Counters>
  </DNP3PointList>
</DNP3DeviceProfile>

title: Distributed Feeder Recloser Telemetry & Freeze Counters
description: JSON DNP3 outstation profile for an automated 12.47 kV distribution recloser featuring three-phase fault current telemetry, hot-line tag interlocks, and interval freeze energy counters.

title: Master SCADA & Dual Substation Outstation Architecture
description: Multi-file IEEE 1815 SCADA architecture coordinating a central EMS master concentrator with two regional transmission substation outstations for coordinated tie-line control and telemetry.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<DNP3DeviceProfile xmlns="http://www.dnp.org/DNP3/DeviceProfile/2010" id="EMS_MASTER_CONCENTRATOR">
  <DeviceIdentity>
    <Vendor>Siemens Energy</Vendor>
    <DeviceName>Spectrum Power 7 DNP3 Front-End Processor</DeviceName>
    <Version>7.4.1</Version>
  </DeviceIdentity>
  <CommunicationSettings>
    <OutstationAddress>1</OutstationAddress>
    <MasterAddress>0</MasterAddress>
  </CommunicationSettings>
  <DNP3PointList>
    <BinaryInputs>
      <BinaryInput index="0" name="SUB_A_LINK_ONLINE" class="1" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="1" name="SUB_B_LINK_ONLINE" class="1" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="2" name="TIE_LINE_CLOSED" class="1" normalState="1"/>
      <BinaryInput index="3" name="AGC_REGULATION_ACTIVE" class="2" normalState="1"/>
    </BinaryInputs>
    <BinaryOutputs>
      <BinaryOutput index="0" name="POLL_INTEGRITY_ALL"/>
      <BinaryOutput index="1" name="TIE_LINE_EMERGENCY_TRIP"/>
    </BinaryOutputs>
    <AnalogInputs>
      <AnalogInput index="0" name="AREA_CONTROL_ERROR_MW" class="2" deadband="0.5" mult="0.1" offset="0.0" units="MW" min="-200" max="200"/>
      <AnalogInput index="1" name="TIE_LINE_FLOW_MW" class="2" deadband="1.0" mult="0.1" offset="0.0" units="MW" min="-500" max="500"/>
      <AnalogInput index="2" name="SYSTEM_FREQ_HZ" class="2" deadband="0.01" mult="0.001" offset="60.0" units="Hz" min="58" max="62"/>
    </AnalogInputs>
    <AnalogOutputs>
      <AnalogOutput index="0" name="SUB_A_GEN_DISPATCH_MW" units="MW" min="0" max="350"/>
      <AnalogOutput index="1" name="SUB_B_BESS_DISPATCH_MW" units="MW" min="-100" max="100"/>
    </AnalogOutputs>
    <Counters>
      <Counter index="0" name="NET_INTERCHANGE_MWH" class="3" units="MWh"/>
    </Counters>
  </DNP3PointList>
</DNP3DeviceProfile>
